description: This file defines the class pScatter used for drawing and managing scatter charts, including plotting points, lines, thresholds, and legends on a chart using a charting library. It contains methods for rendering scatter plots, spline lines, thresholds, labels, and legends, as well as managing axes and scales.

classes.name: pScatter
classes.description: Class for drawing scatter charts, including scatter plots, lines, thresholds, labels, and legends, utilizing an underlying charting object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the chart and data objects.

methods.name: drawScatterPlotChart
methods.description: Draws a scatter plot based on the data series.

methods.name: drawScatterLineChart
methods.description: Draws lines connecting scatter points to form a line chart.

methods.name: writeScatterLabel
methods.description: Draws labels on scatter points with optional box or circle marker.

methods.name: drawScatterThreshold
methods.description: Draws a horizontal or vertical threshold line with optional caption.

methods.name: drawScatterThresholdArea
methods.description: Draws a rectangular threshold area with border and label.

methods.name: drawScatterLegend
methods.description: Draws the legend box for scatter series.

methods.name: getScatterLegendSize
methods.description: Calculates size of the legend box based on series descriptions.

methods.name: drawScatterBestFit
methods.description: Draws the line of best fit for scatter data.

methods.name: getPosArray
methods.description: Converts data values into chart pixel positions according to axes.
